migration_rules: V5 and execution-v1 bytes are never modified
P0 contains no executable implementation and creates no formal experiment artifact
README is history only and is not copied as active v2 documentation

GENERIC.md, ENHANCED.md, and REVIEWER-SCHEMA.json are copied byte-for-byte only in P1_CORE_SCHEMA_FREEZE after exact v2 compatibility validation; incompatibility stops P1 for a fresh reviewed candidate
activation postdates a historical orchestration candidate and authenticates only new package receipts/candidates, never retroactive lifecycle provenance
orchestration_candidate_ref is SHA256(SPEC raw bytes plus NUL plus bounded diff raw bytes); controlling code-review candidate_ref always equals it and is never redefined by the package
package_candidate_sha256 is a separate package identity; current P0 freezes both before a package manifest, and later manifests/receipts bind both without equality or cyclic preimages

package exports use fixed-order export_ids and exact ordered {export_id,files,exported_contract_sha256} objects; P0 derives the sole p0-contracts export in memory from the seven contract raw-byte hashes with no artifact or manifest
implementation_phase and execution_phase are separate closed axes
phase and repair manifests are immutable versioned paths with explicit bounded review attempts; no overwrite or scan/newest
same-phase manifests bind module content/export hashes and DAG edges rather than unavailable pin hashes
after shared dual PASS, fresh pins issue topologically and reference only already-issued same-candidate dependency pins
repair manifests retain exact unchanged old pins with their original review hashes and fresh same-review closure content
P2 resolves and fingerprints the current absolute executable before route/composition dual review; no execution-v1 absolute path is carried and production accepts no override
migration carries no GO, authorization, lifecycle fact, qualification, mutation evidence, RAW, score, result, or STATE authority
Class M labels or bytes cannot be promoted to Class S
simulated capture cannot become real qualification
P3 positive is exactly ZERO_CALL_IMPLEMENTATION_COMPLETE; P3_GO is invalid
activation_scope hash preimage is canonical exact allowed_paths/orchestrator_agent_id/task_id/user_authorization/workspace_id
phase_id originates in immutable PHASE_PLAN issued after candidate freeze and before review; plans are excluded from candidate preimages
post-PASS manifests bind exact controlling records; PHASE_REVIEW is attestation only and does not fabricate lifecycle
module content hashes ordered path/raw-byte hashes and dependency edges using the exact module-content/1 preimage
formal and qualification orphan status/audit receipts are authoritative fixed-path facts; unknown remains IN_PROGRESS
qualification CAPTURE-GATE is consumed before waiting-child release and CAPTURE-SUMMARY/adapter_result close finalization
Class S requires distinct waiting direct children and fixed MUTATION_PLAN before dispatch
discovery/confirmation authorization and all eleven gates use closed ordered inputs; P1/P2/P3 explicitly chain prior phase gate hashes
